comments.overrides.jose: firebase-admin -> jwks-rsa 4.x require()s jose, but jose 6 is ESM-only, so the call only works on Node >= 20.19 / 22.12. On an older runtime — which is what Vercel gave us — loading firebase-admin threw ERR_REQUIRE_ESM and every /api request died with FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED. jose 5 still ships a CommonJS build, and jwks-rsa only uses importJWK and exportSPKI, which are identical in both.
